title: MERID: Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.36235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) severely impacts daily activities and quality of life. Detecting MDD involves multimodal data, such as interview recordings and sensor measurements. This is particularly challenging, as these heterogeneous modalities often demand distinct, customized prediction pipelines. Existing efforts to address this challenge have explored both manually engineered multimodal architectures and agent-assisted pipeline development. Despite their progress, it remains challenging to autonomously revise pipelines based on experimental feedback and carry verified improvements forward into subsequent designs. translated_title: MERID：基于递归自我改进智能体的多模态探索方法用于重度抑郁症分析
translated_abstract: 重度抑郁症（MDD）严重影响患者的日常活动和生活质量。检测MDD涉及多模态数据，例如访谈录音和传感器测量。这项工作尤其具有挑战性，因为这些异构模态通常需要不同的、定制化的预测流程。为应对这一挑战，现有工作已探索了人工设计的多模态架构以及智能体辅助的流程开发方法。尽管取得了一定进展，但如何基于实验反馈自主修改流程，并将经过验证的改进延续到后续设计中，仍然是一个难题。为此，我们提出了MERID（基于递归自我改进智能体的多模态探索框架）用于重度抑郁症分析。该框架通过基于经验的递归自我改进（RSI）来构建抑郁症分析流程。其中，接地状态构建（GSC）通过将多模态记录与被试信息对齐来为经验提供接地基础。
tldr: 提出了MERID框架，利用基于经验的递归自我改进智能体来自主开发和迭代优化多模态抑郁症检测流程，并将经验证的改进延续到后续设计中。
en_tdlr: MERID is proposed as a framework that autonomously develops and iteratively refines multimodal depression detection pipelines through experience-based recursive self-improvement agents, carrying verified improvements forward into subsequent designs.
